rows.title: Register as Volunteer
rows.description: Apply to volunteer for BJP TN

data.body:
📋 *Register for Schemes*

Enter your *EPIC (Voter ID)* number to get started.

Your EPIC is on your voter card — e.g. *TNA1234567*

👇 If you don't have your voter ID, tap below.

🤝 *Register as Volunteer*

Enter your *EPIC (Voter ID)* number to continue.

Your EPIC is on your voter card — e.g. *TNA1234567*

👇 If you don't have your voter ID, tap below.

✅ *Support Request Received!*

Our team will respond within *2 hours*.

For urgent help:
📞 *+91 94444 XXXXX*
⏰ 8am – 10pm daily

Thank you! 🙏

📝 *Please Enter Your Full Name*

Type your full name in the message box below and send it.

_Example: Vijay Kumar_

Once sent, tap *Continue* to select your district.

📍 *Select Your District* (Page 1 of 5)

Choose your district from the list below:

🎯 *Select Schemes* (Page 1 of 4)

Tap a scheme to add it. You can pick from multiple pages.
Tap *Done Selecting* when finished.
